meta.name: Talmar Romeo Juliet
meta.description: A budding romance stirs up an all-out war between two rival families in the little hamlet of Talma, where a shocking twist flips everything upside down. Will love conquer all, or will history repeat its tragic end in this quirky twist on William Shakespeare's classic?

videos.title: S1.E1 ∙ Challenge Nibina Sala
videos.overview: Rana and Jahanara's love dares to bloom even as their families' feud goes from bad to worse.
